> Argos test seems to detect the changes in image compression again

cc @oliviertassinari

@vvo I have tried increasing the color threshold without any success in https://github.com/argos-ci/argos/pull/337. I might have to replace ImageMagick with a custom implementation better-supporting imperceptible changes. For now, I have accepted the diff. Another alternative would be to load deterministic jpg or even hiding them in the screenshots.
